title: Han Lie's Arrogance
next_chapter_hook: Before dying, the old wandering cultivator stuffed a blood-stained map fragment into Chen Ji's hand, whispering: 'Chen Xuan's ruins... you are his descendant... Remember, the things there... must never fall into the hands of the Eyes of Heavenly Dao...'

text.content: The morning mist had yet to dissipate, and a stale earthy smell pervaded the air at the ruins' entrance. Chen Ji lowered his head, broom in hand, presenting the harmless appearance of a menial servant. Morning light slanted from behind him, casting a thin shadow on the ground. However, just as he was about to make his first sweep, a domineering figure descended from the sky, crashing onto the Blue Stone Steps at the ruins' entrance.

dialogue.content: Hmph, this dump qualifies as ruins? Not even a proper formation in sight.

text.content: Han Lie wore black iron heavy armor, his qi and blood surging like a rainbow. Each step he took made the ground tremble slightly. Behind him, over a dozen Xuanwu Sect disciples stood in perfect formation, each with robust auras, firmly encircling the ruins' entrance. The wandering cultivators retreated in fear, their faces filled with dread. Someone whispered: 'It's over, the Xuanwu Sect is here...' Chen Ji's broom didn't stop, but his peripheral vision captured everything, a barely perceptible smile curving his lips.

dialogue.content: From today onward, these ruins belong to the Xuanwu Sect. Anyone wishing to enter must pay ten thousand spirit stones, no exceptions, no credit.

text.content: The crowd erupted. Ten thousand spirit stones! This was an astronomical figure! An ordinary wandering cultivator couldn't gather such an amount even by selling everything they owned. A white-haired elder stepped forward trembling, voice shaking: 'Young Master Han, this old one is a three-star wandering cultivator who has waited over three months here, just to explore the opportunities within these ruins... I implore Young Master to show mercy and allow this old one to enter...' As he spoke, he was about to kneel.

Han Lie didn't even lift his eyelids, simply waving his sleeve. A violent burst of energy swept out, and the elder let out a miserable cry as he flew backward like a broken kite, crashing several zhang away onto the ground, spitting blood. A little girl with double-bun hair rushed over, tears streaming down her face: 'Grandpa! Grandpa!' The elder struggled to raise his head, his eyes filled with despair and unwillingness as he stared at Han Lie.

Chen Ji's fingers gripping the broom tightened slightly, his knuckles turning white. He recognized this grandfather-granddaughter pair—the elder was Zhou De, a well-known upright wandering cultivator in this area, who had shared a piece of dry food with Chen Ji just days ago. And the little girl, Zhou Xiaodie, though her cultivation talent was ordinary, had a pure and kind heart, once helping Chen Ji pick up his fallen broom. At this moment, an irresistible rage surged in Chen Ji's heart, yet his face remained as calm as still water.

dialogue.content: Young Master Han, I beg you to save my grandfather... We are willing to give everything, please!

text.content: Zhou Xiaodie knelt on the ground, kowtowing desperately to Han Lie, the sound of her forehead striking the Blue Stone floor sharp and jarring, quickly becoming a bloody mess. Han Lie merely glanced at her as if looking at an ant, then turned to his disciple beside him: 'Clean up the entrance, don't let these flies buzz around.' With that, he walked straight into the depths of the ruins, as if everything here had nothing to do with him.

Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. The Tianji Record trembled slightly in his Mental Sea, and a scene flooded into his mind like a tide—he saw Han Lie entering the ruins and opening a hidden mechanism in the side hall, retrieving a Jade Slip that emanated a ghostly blue glow. And on this Jade Slip was clearly engraved an ancient symbol, that was... Chen Xuan's mark!

choice.prompt: Chen Ji witnessed Han Lie's atrocities, murderous intent churning in his heart, yet he knew well he could not reveal his strength. How should he act?

choices.text: Publicly expose Han Lie's secret possession of Chen Xuan's Jade Slip
choices.description: Using the scene foreseen by the Tianji Record, expose Han Lie's greedy face before everyone, ruining his reputation completely.
choices.visible_reward: The wandering cultivators' admiration and following
choices.risk_hint: Revealing the Tianji Record's ability may bring greater troubles

text.content: Chen Ji slowly rose to his feet, the broom planted on the ground, his voice not loud yet clearly reaching everyone's ears: 'Young Master Han certainly carries himself with great authority. I merely wonder, what is that Jade Slip you just hid beneath the stone statue in the side hall?'

choices.text: Secretly guide public opinion to kill with a borrowed knife
choices.description: Not appear personally, but cleverly guide the wandering cultivators' anger, letting them spontaneously confront Han Lie.
choices.visible_reward: Han Lie and the wandering cultivators' conflict intensifies, reaping the benefits as the旁观者渔翁
choices.risk_hint: May trigger violent conflict, harming innocents

text.content: Chen Ji swept the ground with an air of casualness, his lips moving slightly as he whispered a few words to the old wandering cultivator beside him. The old man's expression shifted, and he immediately cried out loudly: "Everyone! This ruin was clearly discovered by us first—why should Han Lie just claim it as he pleases!"

choices.text: Save the elder first, bide your time
choices.description: Restrain the fury, save the injured elder first, preserve strength, and wait for a better opportunity to make Han Lie pay the price.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the chance to humiliate him publicly
choices.visible_reward: Gain the elder's trust, lay the groundwork
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie might leave; without timely action, the opportunity will be lost

text.content: Chen Ji set down the broom and strode toward the fallen Zhou De, crouching to examine the injuries. His movements were gentle, his voice audible only to Zhou Xiaodie: "Don't cry—I have a way to save your grandfather." With that, he drew an elixir from his sleeve—a healing panacea he had long prepared.

Han Lie's footsteps abruptly halted as he slowly turned around. A look of disbelief flickered in his eyes—an Outer Disciple/Servant actually dared to question him publicly? He scrutinized Chen Ji from head to toe, as if observing a jumping clown. The surrounding wandering cultivators were also stunned, scarcely daring to believe their ears. Zhou Xiaodie clutched her grandfather's wound, gazing up at Chen Ji with eyes full of surprise and gratitude.

dialogue.content: Menial Servant, where do you get the courage? When Xuanwu Sect is handling matters, it's not for a floor-sweeper like you to comment!

text.content: Chen Ji raised his head, his gaze calmly meeting Han Lie's. No fear graced his features; a faint, almost imperceptible smile even lingered at the corner of his mouth. This composure, in Han Lie's eyes, provoked more rage than terror would have. "Brat, are you tired of living?" Han Lie's aura exploded outward, the Foundation Building Seventh Stage's pressure crushing down on Chen Ji like a mountain. The surrounding wandering cultivators staggered backward, barely able to maintain their footing.

Yet Chen Ji remained unmoved. He merely spoke calmly, his voice soft yet distinctly carrying to each person's ears: "Young Master Han, why must you be so agitated? This one merely harbors curiosity—what characters are inscribed on the Jade Slip hidden beneath the statue in the side hall? Could they be the two characters 'Chen Xuan'?" At these words, Han Lie's complexion drastically changed. His hand unconsciously reached toward the storage bag at his waist, a flicker of panic passing through his eyes.

The declaration sparked immediate commotion. Wandering cultivators whispered among themselves, their gazes toward Han Lie now filled with scrutiny and indignation. So there was a clue to the Chen Xuan ruins within this site! No wonder Xuanwu Sect wanted to monopolize the location! Recognizing his own misstep, Han Lie's face turned ashen, and he barked: "Complete nonsense! Men, seize this babbling servant for me!"

choice.prompt: Han Lie commanded his disciples to seize Chen Ji, while the group of wandering cultivators seethed with agitation—a tense confrontation looming. How should Chen Ji navigate this precarious situation?

choices.text: Continue exposing the truth, humiliate him to the end
choices.description: Since the facade has already been torn away, might as well thoroughly expose Han Lie's true colors, making him lose all face before everyone.
choices.visible_reward: Reputation greatly increased, gain followers among wandering cultivators
choices.risk_hint: Xuanwu Sect has many disciples, may suffer an immediate loss

text.content: Chen Ji coldly laughed: "Senior Chen Xuan was once a benefactor to all wandering cultivators under heaven; the ruins he left behind should belong to all people. Young Master Han monopolizes opportunities and bullies fellow cultivators—how is this different from the Demonic Path of old?" At these words, the surrounding wandering cultivators erupted in approval. Han Lie's complexion cycled between green and white, his fists grinding audibly.

choices.text: Stop at the right moment, retreat to advance
choices.description: Know when to stop, plant seeds of doubt in everyone's hearts, avoid direct confrontation with Han Lie.
choices.visible_cost: Unable to witness Han Lie's embarrassment on the spot
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength, make Han Lie lose sleep over worry
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie might settle accounts later

text.content: Chen Ji let out a soft sigh and said nothing more. He merely bowed slightly, stepped aside, picked up the broom and continued sweeping. But his gaze swept meaningfully over the storage pouch at Han Lie's waist. This gaze made Han Lie feel like a thorn in his flesh, yet he could not vent his anger. The surrounding wandering cultivators had already started whispering, their eyes holding more scrutiny when looking at Han Lie.

choices.text: Naming Su Qingyao, using a borrowed blade to kill
choices.description: Mentioning that Inner Disciple Senior Fellow Su Qingyao of Tianqing Sect is also paying attention to this matter, using Tianqing Sect's influence to suppress Han Lie.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing the connection with Su Qingyao
choices.visible_reward: Han Lie投鼠忌器, not daring to act rashly
choices.risk_hint: Might attract Su Qingyao's attention, being watched by her

text.content: Chen Ji glanced at the crowd as if casually, and said lightly: 'By the way, Su Qingyao of Tianqing Sect was also investigating the periphery of the ruins yesterday. I wonder what she would think if she knew about what happened here?' Han Lie's expression slightly changed upon hearing this. Although he was the number one genius of Xuanwu Sect, Su Qingyao of Tianqing Sect was equally a top-tier figure among the three major sects.

Han Lie took a deep breath, forcefully suppressing the fury in his heart. He knew today was not suitable for action—killing a servant in front of so many wandering cultivators would only confirm his evil reputation. He coldly snorted and swept his sleeves, leaving. Before departing, he fiercely glared at Chen Ji, that gaze filled with sinister warning. Yet Chen Ji seemed not to notice, continuing to sweep while sweeping, only his fingers gripping the broom were slightly white.

The crowd gradually dispersed. Chen Ji walked to Zhou De, squatted beside him to examine his injuries. The old man's organs had all sustained severe damage. Had it not been for the elixir he had timely administered, the old man would have already died. Zhou Xiaodie knelt beside, kowtowing with tears streaming down her face: 'Thank you, Brother Chen, for saving my life!' Chen Ji helped her up, his voice calm: 'No need to thank me.' His gaze fell on the old man, his eyes revealing a complex expression.

dialogue.content: Little brother, are you... a descendant of Senior Chen Xuan?

text.content: Chen Ji's heart trembled, yet his expression remained composed: 'Elder, why do you say that?' The old man painfully took out a yellowed silk from his chest, covered in complex patterns—a fragmented map. 'My Zhou family... has guarded the secret of Chen Xuan's ruins for generations... This map was passed down from our ancestors...' His voice grew fainter and fainter, yet his eyes sparkled with an unusual light.

dialogue.content: Chen Xuan's ruins... are in the deepest part of the ruins... there lies his ultimate inheritance... but...cough... you must be very careful... the Heavenly Fate's Eye... it has always been... searching...

text.content: Before his words could finish, the old man's body suddenly convulsed violently. Black blood poured from his ears, nose, mouth—these were symptoms of severe poison—Han Lie's palm strike had hidden a lethal technique! Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, grabbing the old man's hand, yet he felt the life force rapidly fading. Zhou Xiaodie screamed and pounced forward, the scene descending into chaos.

dialogue.content: Take this... this is... my Zhou family's mission... from today onward... I pass it to you...

text.content: The old man stuffed the blood-stained map fragment into Chen Ji's hand, gripping his hand with his last ounce of strength. Those clouded old eyes burned with a final light: 'Senior Chen Xuan... said... Heavenly Secrets... must not be revealed... but you... must...' The final word never left his lips. The old man's hand fell, his breath ceased. Zhou Xiaodie flung herself over her grandfather, crying her heart out.

Chen Ji knelt silently on the ground, the map still carrying the old man's warmth clutched in his hand. His face showed no expression, but the joints of his fingers gripping the map were white. After a long while, he stood up, carefully tucking the map into his sleeve, then gently patted Zhou Xiaodie's head: 'My condolences.' His voice was soft, yet carried an unwavering determination: 'Your grandfather's revenge, I will remember.'

Before the wandering cultivator elder died, he stuffed a blood-stained map fragment into Chen Ji's hand, whispering: 'Chen Xuan's ruins... you are his descendant... Remember, the things there... must never fall into the hands of the Heavenly Fate's Eye...'
